{{Quote|I don't know how [Heta Kol] did it, but these groups should be slitting each other's throats, not working together.|Shae Vizla, on the Hidden Chain's attack|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] inner struggle, the forces of the [[Hidden Chain]] '''attacked''' the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]], the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
